heroSlogan: Your new beginning in Vancouver starts here!
heroDescription: Zippling has officially arrived in Vancouver! We gather all the information you need for a new life in one place, connecting you to a more convenient and abundant life.
promoDescription: Our unique community is finally complete! Find carefully selected room share & homestay information, useful shopping guides, essential information for beginners, and the latest job postings, all in one place!
readGuideLinkText: Check out the essential guide for settling in Vancouver!
whyZipplingDescription:
Zippling was born from real experiences of finding a home in Vancouver.
As a developer and a foreigner, I, like many others, struggled with the unfamiliar housing system in a new culture.

When rules and communication methods differ, information barriers inevitably arise.
Zippling aims to break down those barriers and empower you to make the best choices with confidence.
